faq.title: Common Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

0.question: How fast can you deliver?
0.answer: Landing pages ship in under a week. Redesigns and branding in 2–3 weeks. MVPs and AI projects in 2–4 weeks. Full-stack applications in 4–10 weeks. You'll see real progress within the first few days.

1.question: What kind of support do I get after launch?
1.answer: Every project includes ongoing support and maintenance, regardless of tier. Bug fixes, performance monitoring, and small adjustments are covered. We treat post-launch support as a core part of the service, not an upsell.

2.question: Can you work with an existing codebase?
2.answer: Yes. We regularly extend existing Next.js apps, connect to third-party APIs, and migrate legacy stacks. We can also audit your codebase to identify technical debt before starting.

3.question: What tech stack do you use?
3.answer: Next.js, React, and TypeScript for web. PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM for data. Vercel for hosting. OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini for AI. We pick the right tool for each job. No trend-chasing.

4.question: How does pricing work?
4.answer: Flat-rate pricing starting at €1,000. No hourly billing, no surprise fees. You get a proposal with exact scope, timeline, and cost before we start. Revisions within scope are always included.

5.question: What's the difference between Starter and Build?
5.answer: Starter covers landing pages, redesigns, and SEO. Projects that are scoped tightly and ship fast. Build is for MVPs, full-stack apps, and AI automation. Projects that involve databases, APIs, authentication, and more complex architecture.

6.question: When does a retainer make sense?
6.answer: When you need continuous development. New features, iterations, performance work, or just someone reliable on call. A retainer gives you reserved weekly capacity at a predictable monthly cost. Cancel anytime.

7.question: What's your process like?
7.answer: Transparent and fast. You get a direct communication channel (Slack, Discord, or email, your choice), weekly demos, and a live staging environment. We ship incrementally so you see progress every few days.

8.question: Not sure where to start?
8.answer: Book a free 30-minute call. We'll assess your situation and recommend the right starting point, whether that's a Starter project or a full Build engagement.
